config.starts: exact ordinary multi-start seeds from high_fold
config.box: same archived physical box; solve ordinary GN linear model with box step bound; componentwise clip p/beta for legal deflated trials
config.regularization: original quadratic + smooth TV carried as exact least-squares residual and Jacobian
config.inner_solver: box-constrained full J linearized least squares with 1e-10 damping; convex quadratic L-BFGS-B
config.merit: original Phi; backtracking Armijo for ordinary steps; deflated steps taken without a merit check
config.incumbent: archived bad endpoint available to both arms; initial physical evaluation charged to both
